prompt: Why was Friday added to the first trial?
promptZh: 第一輪為什麼增加週五巡查？
evidence: The west wing showed no improvement for its window pots in the first two weeks.
Those pots dry out sooner than the ones near the lift.

options.text: The caretaker could no longer visit on Tuesday.
options.zh: 維護人員週二無法再來。
options.why: The Friday check supplemented rather than replaced Tuesday.
options.whyZh: 週五巡查是新增的，不是取代週二。

options.text: The lift pots were drying before Tuesday.
options.zh: 電梯附近的盆栽週二前就乾了。
options.why: The document singles out west window pots, not lift pots.
options.whyZh: 文中指出的是西翼靠窗盆栽，不是電梯旁盆栽。

options.text: The trial needed a second reading from the water meter.
options.zh: 試行需要記第二次水表讀數。
options.why: The visit was to check pots, not a meter.
options.whyZh: 新增的是盆栽巡查，不是抄水表。

options.text: A subset of pots was drying faster and had not improved.
options.zh: 有一部分盆栽乾得較快，也沒有改善。
options.why: These linked observations justified an extra check only at the windows.
options.whyZh: 乾得快且沒有改善，才只對靠窗盆栽追加巡查。
